messages:

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed capacity increase + SOW tweaks

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the demo last week. We ran internal sizing and want to move forward with an additional 2x baseline capacity starting Jan 1, 2027. Couple of asks from procurement/legal before we lock:

- Can you provide an amendment template that adds the new GPU capacity and a clear fee schedule?
- We need proration language for onboarding month (Jan) — Nova expects billing to start on activation date, pro-rated to the nearest day.
- One small SOW change: they want an explicit integration window moved from 6 weeks to 8 weeks.

Attaching our suggested SOW (with comments) and the current order form for reference. Can you route to legal and let me know the timeline for redlines? We have a renewal review on Nov 18 and would like to have a signed amendment earlier if possible.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Martin
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nova Systems
alex.martin@novasystems.com

Folks — forwarding Nova's request. High level: they want +2x capacity (reserve) with a fee schedule change, proration for Jan activation, and an SOW timeline extension.

Immediate asks / owners:
- Karthik: can you draft the amendment (order form + fee table) and include the recommended proration clause. Keep the billing model aligned to our standard "activation" billing (prefer monthly in arrears) but include an optional proration in the amendment if Nova insists.
- Marissa: please review for contract language and flag any exposure around SLA or pricing rollback language. We should decide whether to keep the existing SLA or add a temporary exception during the expanded onboarding.
- Jordan: coordinate DocuSign flow and confirm procurement's signature path (who signs on behalf of Nova).

Target: internal redlines back to Alex by EOD Fri 11/6 so they can review before Nov 18. If there are blocking legal items, raise immediately.

Thanks —
Irene

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft amendment + proration clause (DEAL-4872)

Marissa / Irene —

Attached is my first pass: redlined_orderform_20261103.pdf. Key points I put in the amendment:
- Capacity add: +2x baseline (listed SKU and monthly throughput fees).
- Billing: charges begin on activation date; for partial months we propose charging pro rata by day using (monthly fee / days in month) * active days.
- One-time onboarding fee (covering additional integration support) included as separate line item.
- SOW: updated integration window to 8 weeks and added a milestone-based acceptance schedule.

Open questions I flagged for legal:
1) Do we want language preserving our SLA and remedies or allow a capped liability carveout during onboarding?
2) Should we include an automatic rollback if utilization doesn't materialize within the first 60 days? (Nova asked about credits if usage is below X).

Marissa — I left a comment in the order form PDF where you should propose precise legal language for the proration and the rollback/credit approach if required.

Karthik
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlined_orderform_20261103.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Draft amendment + proration clause (DEAL-4872)

I reviewed the draft and added tracked changes in Nova_SOW_v3_redlines.docx. Summary of legal positions:

- Proration: Accept the daily proration formula you proposed but add a brief example and require the customer to confirm activation date in writing to avoid disputes.
- SLA: Keep our standard SLA intact. If Nova wants a temporary exception, we can add a limited carveout but cap it to 30 days and require mutual sign-off. Recommend keeping SLA to avoid setting a precedent.
- Rollback/Credits: We should avoid an automatic rollback clause. Instead propose a performance review at 60 days with a discretionary credit (up to one month's fee) if materially underutilized and subject to written remediation plan.
- Billing terms: Clarified invoicing cadence (monthly in arrears) and added banking/payment details in Exhibit B.

I've prepared suggested contract language for the amendment and SOW edits (see attachments). From a risk perspective the only real negotiation point is the rollback/credit ask — present as discretionary to limit exposure.

I'll be on leave Fri 11/6 morning but will be available after 1pm PT for a quick review call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nova_SOW_v3_redlines.docx

From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@novasystems.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@novasystems.com
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft amendment + proration clause (DEAL-4872)

Irene / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and Marissa for the language. A few comments from our side after internal review:

- Proration formula looks fine. We'll confirm activation date once infra schedule is locked (tentative 2027-01-10).
- SLA carveout: we can accept the standard SLA but request a 45-day operational ramp window with no credits during ramp. If you keep SLA fully in place, Nova asks for a one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of the one-month fee if the integration is delayed beyond 10 business days past the target date.
- Rollback/credit: Nova prefers a stronger utilization guarantee. Instead of an automatic rollback, propose a 2-month performance window and a single credit (up to 50% of one month's fee) if utilization is <30% against the reserved throughput and remediation fails.

We are OK with the amended SOW timeline (8 weeks) — that aligns with our internal plan. If you can get a final redline by EOD Wed 11/10, procurement here will route for signature.

Alex
Alex Martin
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nova Systems
